_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Overload and Fault Analysis Report
summary: Documents the ability of an electrical power system to safely operate in the presence of overloads and faults, substantiating an airworthiness certification for the system.
use_relationship:
The Overload and Fault Analysis Report documents the ability of an electrical power system to safely operate in the presence of overloads and faults. The data will be used to substantiate an airworthiness certification for the system.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the Overload and Fault Analysis Report resulting from fault analysis tasking described by the contract statement of work.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall include the following:

children.title: All unique overload and fault conditions
An electrical bond impedance analysis
children.content: of the electrical power system and utilization equipment, including:

children.title: Bond impedances needed to meet grounding and bonding requirements
Predicted bond impedances for each piece of utilization equipment
Current carrying capacity of conductors and insulation, including system structural components
A circuit isolation and fault analysis
children.content: of the electrical power system, including:

children.title: The ability of the system to isolate faults
The location of each simulated fault
children.content: and the physical location and electrical connections of the element that interrupted the fault

children.title: The ability of the system to operate
children.content: during and after clearing faults, including

children.title: The mission impact of each cleared fault
The mission impact of the faults that cannot be cleared
All damage prevention schemes used in the system
Circuit protection equipment
Methods of power regulation and control
The ability of each scheme to safely interrupt faults
children.content: and sustain overloads without creating a fault

children.title: The response time of damage prevention schemes to overloads and faults
The ability of the system to prevent and isolate arc faults
Steady state voltages
Transient voltages
The methods used to prevent the connection
children.content: of each source to any other source
